s: ALTB-268 is an engineered antibody that helps regulate the immune system by activating a receptor called PSGL-1. When the immune system is imbalanced, certain T-cells (white blood cells that help the immune system protect the body from disease) can become overactive. ALTB-268 regulates these cells by inhibiting their function, which helps restore balance to the immune system. ALTB-268 works in a similar way to AltruBio’s first-generation antibody, ALTB-168.
